description: This file contains PHP classes for a specialized MSSQL database driver supporting the '||' concatenation operator and extending existing MSSQL driver and recordset classes.

classes.name: ADODB_mssqlpo
classes.description: A subclass of ADODB_mssql adding support for portable MSSQL with '||' concatenation operator.

classes.name: ADORecordset_mssqlpo
classes.description: A subclass of ADORecordset_mssql tailored for the 'mssqlpo' database type.

methods.name: PrepareSP
methods.description: Prepares a stored procedure call, replacing '||' with '+' in SQL strings.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, replacing '||' with '+' in the SQL string before executing.
